event.desc: No. 5 "En Nat i Skoven" only. Concert celebrating Hartmann's 70th birthday.

history.p: Ludvig Holberg's play "Kilderejsen" had its first performance at The Royal Theatre in Copenhagen on 30 June 1750. During the seasons 1858-59 and 1859-60 an intermedium, which Johan Ludvig Heiberg had asked the ballet master August Bournonville to draw up to the music of Hartmann and a text of Hans Christian Andersen, was performed instead of Act Two. The text of No. 2 is a Danish folk song.
